subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should remaining Control UI active-run reconnect preservation be handled by reviving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, opening a current-main replacement, or declaring the existing Stop/send mitigations sufficient?
rationale: Current main has partial mitigations but lacks active-run identity recovery; choosing the durable reconnect contract and whether to preserve the stale candidate branch requires maintainer ownership judgment.

options.title: Open a current-main replacement
options.body: Implement the active-run recovery contract against the current ui/src/pages/chat and packages/gateway-protocol surfaces while preserving attribution to the existing candidate where useful.

options.title: Revive the existing candidate PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or adopter to rebase the open PR, move protocol work to the current package, address review findings, and add real reconnect proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Close only if maintainers explicitly decide that Stop visibility and queued-send retry are enough and active-run adoption after reconnect is not required.

recommendation.title: Open a current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Implement the active-run recovery contract against the current ui/src/pages/chat and packages/gateway-protocol surfaces while preserving attribution to the existing candidate where useful.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Control UI/protocol repair work makes steipete the best available owner for choosing whether to rebase, replace, or narrow the stale active-run recovery path.
